FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$8,307,100 and 63.5 FTE Positions from the Arizona Medical Board Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Employee Performance Incentive Program

The Baseline includes \$165,600 from the Arizona Medical Board Fund in FY 2027 for the Employee Performance Incentive Program. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

The program was previously funded by a footnote allowing the Arizona Medical Board to use up to 7% of the prior year balance from the Arizona Medical Board Fund. The FY 2019 General Appropriations Act removed that footnote and instead added a line item for the incentive program.

The board awards employees based on performance of certain agency-identified measures, such as the average number of days taken to approve a new license after receiving an application.

Auditor General Report

In September 2025, the Auditor General published a performance audit and sunset review of the Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants, which operates in conjunction with the Arizona Medical Board. The review assessed licensing processes, complaint resolution, publication requirements, and conflict-of-interest rule compliance.

The Auditor General made the following key recommendations with budget implications:

Develop and enforce oversight and accountability mechanisms for board staff, particularly by conducting a comprehensive workload analysis.

Develop and implement written procedures to systematically evaluate fee changes based on board expenses and use historical and projected data to inform the board's budget request.

The board agreed with the Auditor General's findings and intends to implement the recommendations.
